title: PERSONS ARRESTED A total number of 9,63,716 persons were arrested during the year 1967 (for offences under the Indian Penal Code) as compared to 8,81,653 persons arrested during 1966, showing an increase of 9.9% over the previous year. Table 1(a) presents comparative figures of persons arrested and the number of persons involved per case during the last six years, viz. 1962 to 1967. It has been observed that the number of persons involved per case during the aforesaid period, viz., 1962-67, does not show a significant variation.
